name: 700 MHz Decision
evidence_rating: thin: no Commission evaluation yet; an EU audit of 5G roll-out found delays in the Member States
summary: The Decision required Member States to allow wireless broadband in the 700 MHz band by mid-2020 (with up to two years' delay allowed). The impact assessment expected it to support EU-wide connectivity and economies of scale in equipment; it gave no quantified forecast. No Commission evaluation has been published; the European Court of Auditors found considerable delays in 5G roll-out across Member States in 2022.

indicators.objective: No monitoring indicators set in the proposal; assessed through the Commission's reports listed below
Make the 700 MHz band available for wireless broadband
indicators.indicator: Member States allowing use of the band
indicators.target_or_baseline: by 30 June 2020 (delay up to 2 years for listed reasons)
indicators.evidence: No Commission compliance report found; the ECA audit (2022) reports delays in 5G deployment generally, not band by band.

literature.citation: European Commission (2016), Impact Assessment on the use of the 470-790 MHz frequency band in the Union (executive summary), SWD(2016) 19 (full IA SWD(2016) 20)
literature.title: Impact Assessment on the use of the 470-790 MHz frequency band in the Union (executive summary)
literature.headline: Coordinated release of the 700 MHz band expected to support EU-wide connectivity, avoid interference with broadcasting and gain economies of scale in equipment; preferred option keeps the sub-700 MHz band for broadcasting
literature.summary_plain: The Commission expected a coordinated release of the band to speed up mobile broadband while protecting free-to-air television; it gave no figures.

literature.citation: European Court of Auditors (2022), 5G roll-out in the EU: delays in deployment of networks with security issues remaining unresolved, Special Report 03/2022
literature.title: 5G roll-out in the EU: delays in deployment of networks with security issues remaining unresolved
literature.headline: Member States experienced considerable delays in deploying 5G networks; most unlikely to meet the 2025 coverage goal
literature.summary_plain: EU auditors found that 5G networks, for which the 700 MHz band is a key frequency, were being rolled out with considerable delays.
literature.quality: audit; not specific to the Decision
